The Day-1 dry run now passes end to end on the simulator, and main is pushed. T-034 stays blocked only on the Tantra key that T-337 already asks for.

| Item | State | What I saw this run |
|---|---|---|
| Push main, including cd5590b, no force | Done | Scanned the 16 unpushed commits: no `.dev.vars`, `.env` or `.pem` files, and no key patterns. Pushed `9b2b64b6..5320259f`. Nothing is left unpushed, and cd5590b is on origin. |
| Harness starts its own temporary centre when :8790 is stale | Done | It started a private centre and simulator on free ports, ran, and printed "private stack stopped". None of its processes were left running, and the :8790 process was never touched. |
| Test addresses never bounce, plus one separate bounce case | Done | `cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py` now always delivers to the three test addresses. A fourth "Refusal check" attendee (`[email]`) always bounces; it only exists on the simulator and is never part of a live send. |
| Rerun with all three personas getting email and WhatsApp | Done | Run 20261011-164656, no manual step: SendFlow 10.3 s, Apex Growth 13.4 s, Sarah Chen 14.6 s. The refusal address bounced as designed. The harness's built-in check printed "3 personas got email and WhatsApp, the refusal address bounced". |
| Submit-to-delivery time recorded per persona | Done | The rows are in `workshop-plan/ops/runbook.md` section 6. I also rewrote that section's text to cover the automatic temporary centre and the refusal case. |
| Test rows tagged test afterwards | Done | All four attendees read `test=1 revoked=1` after cleanup. |
| Ripple R-d97e4cc4 (update the waiting-on text) | Done | The waiting-on text now cites T-031 and T-032 as verified (`render_pdf.py`, `probe_outputs.py`, runbook section 6). The only thing left is the T-033 live send. |
| `--require-real` refuses until the Tantra key exists | Done | It still exits with "needs the Tantra key, T-337". |
| Real run with live Tantra send | Blocked on T-337 | Needs the Tantra key. Then run `python3 workshop-plan/ops/dryrun_day1.py --require-real`. No new ask raised. |

The first rerun failed the built-in check because the harness created the delivery campaigns but never started them, so the simulator only queued the sends. The harness now starts them through `/admin/api/delivery/start`. I deleted that failed run's rows and folder; both were output of this harness only.

Committed as 5320259f. T-034 is set to blocked, and both notes (F-b0bea95e and R-d97e4cc4) are acknowledged.
